note: Driver-voice question variants, sampled deterministically by the factory. Committed and reviewable — edit freely, or have an agent bulk-expand any shape. TWO RULES. (1) Every question must stand alone as the FIRST message in a thread: no 'that'/'it' referring to advice the engineer hasn't given yet. (2) Every symptomPhrase must read correctly after 'It's …' and 'Car is …', i.e. a gerund or adjectival phrase ('pushing mid-corner'), never a full clause ('no grip left by the end'). Placeholders: {symptom} = phrase for the run's problem type, {param} = a real tuning parameter.

entry-understeer: running wide as I turn in
on-power-snap: spinning up when I get on it
letting go the moment I squeeze the throttle
traction-roll: tripping over itself in the tight stuff
braking-loose: rear coming around on the brakes
inconsistent: inconsistent, one lap good one lap bad
never the same two laps running
tires-going-off: losing grip towards the end of the run
going away after three or four laps
